title: Royal Navy service member charged with spying for a foreign power
description: The 24-year-old man is due to appear at Westminster Magistrates’ Court on Thursday after being arrested at his home in Bedfordshire.

title: Asos warns customers about full extent of data breach after BBC contacted by hackers
description: Names, addresses, phone numbers, emails and customer numbers are now in the hands of cyber criminals.

title: Most UK diplomats to leave East Jerusalem consulate, Israel says, as Miliband says 'vital services' to remain
description: Israel said in September it would act in response to UK sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank.

title: 'Come all the way' back to EU, French finance minister tells UK
description: Roland Lescure tells the BBC that being in the bloc enables members to better address the challenges facing the world.

title: Christa Pike now walking after failed US execution, lawyer tells BBC
description: A lawyer says the murderer of Colleen Slemmer is moving around her hospital room after surviving two lethal injections.

title: Clubs fear political interference in Man City appeal
description: Premier League clubs are "concerned" about political interference in Manchester City's appeal after Prime Minister Andy Burnham's comments.

title: We spent thousands on a Tui river cruise but ended up on coach trips
description: Passengers have described their anger after their itineraries changed to involve hours spent on coach trips instead.

title: BBC to cut raft of Radio 4 programmes including You and Yours
description: The corporation said it would be investing in a new consumer programme, while announcing more cuts.

title: US and Lebanon protecting wanted Syrian general, BBC finds
description: Bassam al-Hassan is being sheltered in return for information - including about abducted US reporter Austin Tice.
